messages:
maria: heads-up — saw a p95 bump on canary after the attn-transpose merge (commit abc1234). shortseqs (<=32) p95 +12%, GPU mem increases ~8%.
ryan: ack. that was my change. can you paste the traces? :eyes:
maria: quick perf diff from canary vs baseline:
```
canary: decode_shortseq_p95 = 85ms
baseline: decode_shortseq_p95 = 76ms
p95 delta = +12%\nhot functions: attention_transpose_kernel (35%), fused_decode_path (22%), kv_warmup (10%)
flame shows extra memcpy in attn_transpose
```
sam: ran a tiny bisect this morning — narrowed to the transpose reorder in abc1234 -> it changes memory layout before matmul which seems to defeat the fused path and injects a memcpy into the hot loop.
jen: infra-bot flagged the canary: infra-bot: "canary perf check failed: p95 delta 12% > threshold 10% — hold rollout"
ryan: ok. i can push a revert but want to confirm if a kernel hint flag buys us time. can we force the old kernel at runtime?
maria: yes, we have RW_KERNEL_SELECTOR override. local test with `RW_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy_transpose` gives p95 back to 77ms (within noise).
ryan: great. i'll open a quick revert + follow-up PR that exposes a safer matrix-ordering with a test. PR: https://git/repo/pulls/801 (revert of abc1234)
sam: also recommend a microbenchmark added to the shortseq CI suite so this doesn't slip. current CI has an end-to-end but not the tiny decode micro.
jen: agreed — filed ticket INF-452 to add shortseq microbench and a perf guard for attention_transpose_memcopy.
maria: for the triage run i put together steps to reproduce locally:
```
# repro (shortseq)
export RW_KERNEL_SELECTOR=experimental_transpose
bazel run //benchmarks:decode_shortseq -- --seq_len=16 --iters=200
# measure p95 from logs
```
ryan: thanks. i'm going to enqueue the revert and a canary with RW_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy_transpose while PR lands. tagging @sam for follow-up on microbench. :thumbsup:
sam: on it. i'll add the microbench and a perf threshold in the next hour.
jen: keeping this thread for postmortem notes — we should call out that memory layout changes can silently force memcpy fallback in fused paths.
maria: noted. will add a blurb to the release notes and the rollback rationale.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollouts paused for release/2026-03-17 due to perf regression.
